etymology.historical_story: Eliza is documented as a short form of Elizabeth and is also used as an independent given name. A familiar literary bearer is Eliza Doolittle in Pygmalion and its musical adaptation, My Fair Lady. These associations concern the name's history, not the identity, ancestry, religion, or preferred pronunciation of any individual appearing in this dataset.
